messages:
incidents-bot: PAGER: prefill-gpu-oom on runtime-prod (pod runtime-xxxx-7f6b) — container restart loop observed, multiple pods across node pool gpustack-us-west-2. Severity: P1.

Priya (oncall): acknowledging. I'm pulling logs and dashboards now. anyone oncall runtime? @Alex

Alex (runtime): here. seeing spikes in prefill memory when context > 200k tokens (large user sessions). OOM in prefill path, CUDA oom, container restarts.

Priya (oncall): copy. impact? any customer-facing 5xx alerts?

customer-success-bot: Alert: 4 customer apps reported 500s in the last 5m, highest for Acme Inc. (region: us-west-2).

Alex (runtime): digging into pod logs — prefill requests with very long prompt windows appear to allocate full KV cache then crash. snippet:```E /runtime/prefill.cc:412 CUDA out of memory when allocating 134217728 bytes (requested by attention cache) stacktrace...```

Jia (infra): nvidia-smi on node gpu-node-42 shows GPU memory at 98% and process runtime-xxxx at 0.92 of mem. multiple containers pinned to same GPU. possible scheduler fragmentation/noisy neighbor.

Priya (oncall): mitigation plan options: 1) evict offending pods, 2) enable per-request max_context fallback to CPU, 3) relocate prefill-heavy traffic to dedicated pool (if available). Which is fastest?

Alex (runtime): fastest is to enable immediate eviction + fallback to CPU for large contexts. I'll flip the runtime flag to enforce max_prefill_tokens=64k for hosted lane and enable prefix trimming. That will force model to stream and avoid pre-allocating full KV.

Jia (infra): evicting the hot pods on gpu-node-42 now (kubectl drain/evict). Running:```kubectl get pods -n runtime -o wide | grep runtime-xxxx && kubectl delete pod runtime-xxxx-7f6b```

OpsRunbookBot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefill-oom — recommended ephemeral mitigations: evict, enable fallback, scale pool by +2 GPUs, enable prefix trim.

Priya (oncall): executing runtime flag change:```curl -X POST https://runtime-config/api/flags -d '{"max_prefill_tokens":65536,"prefill_trim":true,"prefill_fallback_cpu":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'```

Alex (runtime): flag accepted, pushing to 30% canary across us-west first. Also deploying a hotfix that reduces default batch_size for prefill from 8 -> 4 to reduce transient mem spikes.

Jia (infra): scaling up dedicated pool by 2 g4dn instances as temporary capacity:```terraform apply -var 'pool=dedicated-prefill-usw2'``` — started new instances, ~90s to ASG attach.

Priya (oncall): Acme Impact check: logs show 12 failed requests from Acme in the last 10m, with 502/503. CS alerted. I'm drafting customer note.

customer-success-bot: Suggested msg: "We're investigating increased errors in us-west-2 — mitigation in progress, will update within 30m."

Alex (runtime): after flag and eviction, memory pressure dropping. watching trading dashboard. prefill OOMs dropped from 18/min -> 1/min. JVM (or runtime) restarts still happening on a few nodes (container restart loop count decreasing).

Jia (infra): kube events show the nodes with repeated restarts had fragmented allocations. I triggered kubelet eviction threshold to reclaim ephemeral storage and forced kube-scheduler to spread pods by GPU id.

Priya (oncall): good. I'm going to escalate to a follow-up ticket: root cause triage. high-level: large-context prefill allocations plus scheduler fragmentation -> GPU OOM -> container restarts. We should consider: soft-limits on prefill allocation, long-context quotas, improved packing policy.

Mateo (night-oncall): taking handoff in 30m. Priya, can you summarize the actions and open a short incident summary for on-call log?

Priya (oncall): summary being posted to incident doc. key actions: evicted hot pods, toggled max_prefill_tokens + prefill_trim + fallback_cpu, scaled dedicated pool +2, reduced prefill batch_size to 4. customer impact: Acme and 3 others saw transient 5xx for ~12m. Status: mitigated, residual risk: low but keep monitoring for correlated memory spikes.

Alex (runtime): created PR #4821 (runtime: prefill memory guardrails + packer improvement). linking to thread.

Priya (oncall): adding follow-ups to triage board: (1) telemetry: break out prefill allocation per-request; (2) scheduler: anti-affinity by context-size tag; (3) product: long-context quota/rate-limit.

Jia (infra): nodes stabilized, GPU mem usage at ~35% on affected hosts. container restarts dropped to zero for last 8 minutes.

Priya (oncall): I'll update Acme w/ ETA 60m for full postmortem. Mateo please continue monitoring for 2h and escalate if OOM rate > 2/min. handing off to @Mateo. :handshake: 

Mateo (night-oncall): ack. I have runbook and the flag history. Will watch dashboards and keep channel updated.

OpsRunbookBot: Incident severity lowered to P2 per oncall. Follow-up checklist created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1834567890/followups

Priya (oncall): closing pager loop here. thanks everyone.

Mateo (night-oncall): thanks — will post any anomalies.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: prefill-gpu-oom (1834567890) — mitigation applied, services stable.
